description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an engineering and R&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will design, build, integrate, and test drone-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems.

 - Develop control, navigation, path-planning, and obstacle-avoidance solutions.

 - Build robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C++ or Python, and validate systems in simulation.

 - Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems.

 - Build, troubleshoot, and independently validate robotic systems in the field.

 - Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototypes and deployments.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of hands-on experience building or delivering robotics, UAV, or autonomous systems.

 - Strong fundamentals in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration.

 - Proficiency in C++ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; MATLAB familiarity is useful.

 - Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, and batteries.

 - Knowledge of IMU, GPS/RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS-denied navigation.

 - Embedded systems experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging.

 - Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, flight-log analysis, and field testing.

 - A degree in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field.

 - Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo or Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in Indianapolis, United States.
